seed: Prefer the simplest stateless rule set. Treat every object type that never changes in the data as static scenery and model only the types that change.

synth.notes:
Player 5x5 steps 5 cells (A1-4); dest box off-board or containing wall 4 / void 5 = blocked (still burns 2 bar cells).
Full 5-cell colour-1 strip on a dest edge = conveyor: slide away from it until blocked.
Bar rows 61-62: each action turns the 2 leftmost 11s to 3; a refuel ring inside the landing box is erased and refills the track.
A collect sprite inside the box rotates the 3x3 HUD glyph 90deg CW and stays under the player (continuity-gated cache; stateless 38/40).
Unconfirmed (not in data): chamber entry refused free unless glyph mask+colour == legend; recolor token turns glyph to legend colour.
